text:
maria: Heads-up: we're doing a rolling runtime rollout for hosted inference in the EU tonight during the 22:00-23:00 UTC change window. Need final statuspage copy + customer email and the short rollback checklist. Plan: hosted -> runtime v2.2.0; Dedicated remains on v2.1.x unless customer requests opt-in via form.

deploy-bot: New rollout scheduled: id=rollout-2026-04-01-EU-22, start=2026-04-01T22:00:00Z, canary_region=eu-west-1, window=60m.

jon: I'll set canary to 5% for first 10m, then 25% for next 20m, hold for 10m, then proceed to 100% if healthy. Add automatic revert conditions for p95 > 450ms for 3m OR 5xx_rate > 0.4% sustained 3m.

claire: Support copy draft below. Keeping it neutral and soft on numbers per legal.

support: statuspage snippet (for review):
```
Planned maintenance: Hosted runtime rollout
When: 2026-04-01 22:00 3:00 UTC
What: Rolling upgrade of hosted inference runtime to v2.2.0. A small portion of traffic will be shifted to canaries during the window.
Impact: Some requests routed to canaries may experience transient latency differences. No planned downtime.
If you see issues: contact support@redwood.ai or monitor this page.
```

maria: change "22:00 3:00 UTC" -> "22:00 4:00 UTC" (typo) — actually we mean 22:00-23:00 UTC. also add one liner at top: "Automatic safety revert is enabled for this rollout."

support: Email draft subject: "Maintenance notice: Hosted runtime rollout 3 April, 22:00 UTC"

support: Email body (short):
"Hi —
We will roll the hosted inference runtime to v2.2.0 on 1 April between 22:00 and 23:00 UTC. Most customers should be unaffected. During the canary phase a small subset of requests may see brief performance variance.

Dedicated customers: If you'd like your Dedicated pool upgraded during this window, please complete this opt-in form: https://redwood.ai/forms/dedicated-runtime-optin (reply to your CSM if you need a manual schedule).

Safety: Automatic revert to the prior runtime is enabled and will trigger if stability thresholds are breached.

Support: support@redwood.ai (24/7)
Thanks,
Redwood Ops & Support"

legal: Quick note: avoid numerical SLA-like claims. "Brief performance variance" is fine. Don't promise exact durations.

ops_lead: Short rollback checklist for ops channel:
- Trigger: deploy-bot will auto-pause on conditions. If manual revert required: `trafficctl revert --to=runtime:2.1.9 --selector=hosted`
- Abort rollout job: `deploy-bot cancel rollout-2026-04-01-EU-22`
- Notify: update statuspage to "Partial revert in progress for affected traffic" and post customer email template.
- Post-mortem: capture logs in /runs/rollouts/rollout-2026-04-01-EU-22 and open incident if user-facing errors persist.

jon: I'll add synthetic smoke for canary endpoints and add a dashboard tile for quick p95 view.

claire: Support will queue the pre-announce at 21:30 UTC and the full email at 22:10 UTC after canary passes. If we hit auto-revert we'll send follow-up to customers within 30m.

deploy-bot: Auto-revert thresholds configured: p95_latency > 450ms for 3m OR 5xx_rate > 0.4% for 3m -> action: pause rollout + revert traffic. Notifications enabled to this channel.

maria: Thanks. Two asks before pre-announce: (1) support, attach the opt-in form link to the email and statuspage, (2) ops_lead, confirm runbook shortlink.

ops_lead: Runbook shortlink: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/runtime-rollout. Added to checklist.

claire: Legal has OK'd the copy. Sending pre-announce at 21:30 then monitoring.

maria: Preflight scheduled 21:20 UTC — post results here. If anything unexpected surfaces we'll move the rollout to the backup window tomorrow.

jon: :ok_hand: I'll be on watch for the first 30m.

support: Pre-announce queued. Will follow up with the full statuspage URL once published.

maria: Great work team. If you get alerts after 22:00 call the on-call number and @eng-oncall.
